searchText: we just added 🙂 https://www.etherchain.org/burn `s/GWei/nETH/g` 😋 Geth is reporting a lot of "Bad Blocks" on forkmon, despite the Infura signer (which I assume runs geth?) still producing blocks, and clients being in consensus with each other on Forkmon as well. I'm not sure what could be causing this? https://testnet.forkmon.ethdevops.io/ The RLP encoded blocks are on forkmon, though. Grafitti for c89148 indicates it's nethermind's validator. Same with a71693 Oh, Nethermind is marked unhealthy on forkmon too. cc: <@&652918665943056397> Their validator does seem to produce some correct blocks, e.g. https://goerli.etherscan.io/block/5256738 I'm looking into it now, trying to find some logs to tell me _why_ those blocks are 'bad'... It seems they're fairly old. One of them is at this number: https://goerli.etherscan.io/block/4966175 -- which was 50 days ago Another is even older, `4950726`... I saw some new ones show up on the UI, are they all old ones 🤔 ? Geth actually stores bad blocks to db, so we don't lose all that info at restart. So this may be some issue which was fixed 2-ish months ago a third is `4966175` A fourth `4971377` -- yeah the ones I've checked appear to be sealed around mid June (which explains why I'm not seeing any bad blocks in the logs -- we only have two weeks of history on papertrail ) We have an issue in our Clique plugin that sometimes we too eagerly produce block out of turn (it always looses if in-turn block is produced), maybe that? We were testing some changes back then which had a bug, was fixed Ah great, thanks for confirming! I need to add some rlp-decoder to the forkmon to make life easier going forward Still not sure about forkmon, but we are not mining on mainnet and will only produce blocks after the merge grabbed RLP that appeared on forkmon: Nethermind 1.10.72 Block number: 4950592 Timestamp: 1623412153 ( 11.06.2021 13:49:13 ) so yeah, looks old not sure why its showing them now
